key_insight: CSPO adaptively calibrates sequence-level policy clipping to target a marginal tail budget as reasoning-model training evolves.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive clipping offers a way to align policy-update constraints with whole-response rewards while accounting for changing score distributions.
method: Calibrate sequence-level clipping bounds using recent training statistics.
Target a specified marginal miscoverage level, with explicit corrections for CDF discrepancy and policy drift.
Under additional moment conditions, bound objective and gradient error relative to the unclipped GSPO power surrogate.
evidence_signal: Experiments with the Qwen3-1.7B series report improvements over GSPO on difficult mathematical reasoning benchmarks and ALFWorld, with clipping endpoints adapting during training.
watch_item: Marginal calibration does not guarantee calibration conditional on response length; that requires additional assumptions.
paper_title: Conformal Prediction-Enabled Sequence-level Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models
